@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+package inner
+
+import "os/exec"
+
+func DefaultSpawnHooks(cmd *exec.Cmd, dveID, sessionID string) {
+	cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
+		"KNIRV_DVE_ID="+dveID,
+		"KNIRV_SESSION_ID="+sessionID,
+		"KNIRV_SUPERVISOR=knirvagent",
+		"TERM=xterm-256color",
+		"COLORTERM=truecolor",
+	)
+}

1. Overview

118:

119: Each DVE is auto-provisioned with a dedicated KNIRVAGENT supervisor process on DVE creation. 120: This spec extends that architecture so the KNIRVAGENT supervisor can spawn, monitor, and proxy 121: arbitrary inner agent CLI tools (e.g. claude, aider, codex) 122: inside the DVE workspace. The frontend gains a multi-pane terminal workspace where each inner 123: agent session occupies its own tab alongside the supervisor tab. 124:

125: 126:

Design Principles

127:
    128:
  • All internal communication uses Unix sockets — no TCP between services.
    • 129:
  • KNIRVGATEWAY (:8888) is the sole public-facing proxy. All browser-reachable endpoints must pass through it.
    • 130:
  • New inner agent library code belongs in packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/inner/ and packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/server/ — the binary's own module (github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent).
    • 131:
  • The KNIRVAGENT binary's HTTP server (serverCmd() in cmd/knirvagent/main.go) is extended with new /api/inner/* endpoints, still served over the existing per-DVE Unix socket.
    • 132:
  • KNIRVSERVER manages connections to KNIRVAGENT via packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvagent/manager.go — new proxy helper methods are added there to call the inner endpoints.
    • 133:
  • Every byte written by an inner agent is tee'd: one copy to a supervisor log file, one to subscriber channels (WebSocket streams).

398: type InnerAgentSession struct {
399:     ID           string
400:     ToolName     string
401:     Cmd          *exec.Cmd
402:     PTY          *os.File       // PTY master fd — write = keystrokes, read = output
403:     Status       SessionStatus
404:     StartedAt    time.Time
405:     WorkspaceDir string
406:     DVEID        string
407: 
408:     supervisorLog io.Writer    // written by broadcast(); every byte tee'd here
409: 
410:     mu          sync.RWMutex
411:     subscribers []chan []byte  // one channel per active /stream consumer
412:     done        chan struct{}
413: }
414: 
415: // Subscribe returns a channel that receives every PTY output chunk.
416: // Closed when the session exits. Caller must drain it.
417: func (s *InnerAgentSession) Subscribe() chan []byte {
418:     ch := make(chan []byte, 256)
419:     s.mu.Lock()
420:     s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers, ch)
421:     s.mu.Unlock()
422:     return ch
423: }
424: 
425: func (s *InnerAgentSession) Unsubscribe(ch chan []byte) {
426:     s.mu.Lock()
427:     defer s.mu.Unlock()
428:     for i, sub := range s.subscribers {
429:         if sub == ch {
430:             s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers[:i], s.subscribers[i+1:]...)
431:             return
432:         }
433:     }
434: }
435: 
436: // broadcast tees a PTY output chunk: supervisor log + all subscriber channels.
437: func (s *InnerAgentSession) broadcast(chunk []byte) {
438:     s.supervisorLog.Write(chunk)
439:     s.mu.RLock()
440:     defer s.mu.RUnlock()
441:     for _, ch := range s.subscribers {
442:         select {
443:         case ch <- append([]byte(nil), chunk...):
444:         default: // drop if subscriber is slow
445:         }
446:     }
447: }
448: 
449: // PumpOutput reads from the PTY master and fans out until the process exits.
450: // Run as a goroutine immediately after Spawn.
451: func (s *InnerAgentSession) PumpOutput() {
452:     buf := make([]byte, 4096)
453:     for {
454:         n, err := s.PTY.Read(buf)
455:         if n > 0 {
456:             s.broadcast(buf[:n])
457:         }
458:         if err != nil { break }
459:     }
460:     s.mu.Lock()
461:     s.Status = StatusExited
462:     for _, ch := range s.subscribers { close(ch) }
463:     s.subscribers = nil
464:     s.mu.Unlock()
465:     close(s.done)
466: }

987: func newWebSocketTunnel(socketPath string) http.HandlerFunc {
988:     return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
989:         backendConn, err := net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
990:         if err != nil {
991:             http.Error(w, "backend unavailable", http.StatusBadGateway)
992:             return
993:         }
994:         defer backendConn.Close()
995: 
996:         hijacker, ok := w.(http.Hijacker)
997:         if !ok { http.Error(w, "hijacking not supported", http.StatusInternalServerError); return }
998:         clientConn, buf, err := hijacker.Hijack()
999:         if err != nil { return }
1000:         defer clientConn.Close()
1001: 
1002:         // Replay the original HTTP request to the backend.
1003:         r.Write(backendConn)
1004:         if n := buf.Reader().Buffered(); n > 0 {
1005:             io.CopyN(backendConn, buf, int64(n))
1006:         }
1007: 
1008:         // Bidirectional copy — both sides run concurrently; first done cancels both.
1009:         done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
1010:         go func() { io.Copy(backendConn, clientConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
1011:         go func() { io.Copy(clientConn, backendConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
1012:         <-done
1013:     }
1014: }

684: // serverCmd starts an HTTP server on a Unix socket that accepts command
685: // execution requests. Designed for use as a managed subprocess by KNIRVSERVER's
686: // AgentManager — each DVE gets its own agent process with its own socket.
687: //
688: // Usage: knirvagent server --dve-id <id> --socket-path <path>
689: func serverCmd() {
690: 	dveID := ""
691: 	socketPath := ""
692: 
693: 	args := os.Args[2:]
694: 	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
695: 		switch args[i] {
696: 		case "--dve-id":
697: 			if i+1 < len(args) {
698: 				dveID = args[i+1]
699: 				i++
700: 			}
701: 		case "--socket-path":
702: 			if i+1 < len(args) {
703: 				socketPath = args[i+1]
704: 				i++
705: 			}
706: 		case "--debug", "-d":
707: 			logger.SetLevel(logger.DEBUG)
708: 		case "--help", "-h":
709: 			fmt.Println("Usage: knirvagent server --dve-id <id> --socket-path <path>")
710: 			fmt.Println()
711: 			fmt.Println("Starts the agent as an HTTP server on a Unix socket.")
712: 			fmt.Println("Accepts POST /api/execute for command execution,")
713: 			fmt.Println("GET /health for health checks.")
714: 			return
715: 		}
716: 	}
717: 
718: 	if socketPath == "" {
719: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: --socket-path is required\n")
720: 		os.Exit(1)
721: 	}
722: 
723: 	// Remove any existing socket file
724: 	os.Remove(socketPath)
725: 
726: 	cfg, err := loadConfig()
727: 	if err != nil {
728: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error loading config: %v\n", err)
729: 		os.Exit(1)
730: 	}
731: 
732: 	// Debug: log what the config actually has after loading
733: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
734: 		cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey))
735: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
736: 		cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey))
737: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
738: 		cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey))
739: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
740: 		cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey))
741: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider=%q\n",
742: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
743: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model=%q\n",
744: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model)
745: 
746: 	// Debug: log whether API keys are available as env vars
747: 	for _, key := range []string{"GEMINI_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "CEREBRAS_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY"} {
748: 		if val, ok := os.LookupEnv(key); ok && val != "" {
749: 			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is set (len=%d)\n", key, len(val))
750: 		} else if ok {
751: 			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is set but EMPTY\n", key)
752: 		} else {
753: 			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is NOT SET\n", key)
754: 		}
755: 	}
756: 
757: 	provider, err := createProviderWithFallback(cfg)
758: 	if err != nil {
759: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error creating provider: %v\n", err)
760: 		os.Exit(1)
761: 	}
762: 
763: 	// Build runtime fallback providers so the agent can switch on auth errors.
764: 	// We pre-create each provider here (at startup) so there's no overhead at
765: 	// the time of the actual fallback.
766: 	runtimeFallbacks := buildRuntimeFallbacks(cfg)
767: 
768: 	// Validate the primary provider with a quick test call and promote the
769: 	// first working fallback when the primary key is invalid.  This runs before
770: 	// the socket is created so the parent (AgentManager) always sees the
771: 	// correct provider name in the health endpoint.
772: 	provider, runtimeFallbacks = validateAndPromoteProvider(provider, cfg, runtimeFallbacks)
773: 
774: 	// Create the Unix socket FIRST, before any potentially-blocking agent
775: 	// initialization.  This ensures the parent (AgentManager.StartAgent)
776: 	// sees the socket immediately via waitForSocket, avoiding the 30-second
777: 	// timeout that would otherwise kill the agent process.
778: 	listener, err := net.Listen("unix", socketPath)
779: 	if err != nil {
780: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error listening on socket %s: %v\n", socketPath, err)
781: 		os.Exit(1)
782: 	}
783: 	defer listener.Close()
784: 	defer os.Remove(socketPath)
785: 
786: 	// Set permissions so the backend_server can connect
787: 	os.Chmod(socketPath, 0666)
788: 
789: 	msgBus := bus.NewMessageBus()
790: 	agentLoop := agent.NewAgentLoop(cfg, msgBus, provider)
791: 	agentLoop.SetFallbackProviders(runtimeFallbacks)
792: 
793: 	// Start the agent loop in the background
794: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
795: 	defer cancel()
796: 	go agentLoop.Run(ctx)
797: 
798: 	// Print startup info
799: 	startupInfo := agentLoop.GetStartupInfo()
800: 	toolsInfo := startupInfo["tools"].(map[string]interface{})
801: 	skillsInfo := startupInfo["skills"].(map[string]interface{})
802: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DVE=%s socket=%s tools=%d skills=%d/%d\n",
803: 		dveID, socketPath, toolsInfo["count"], skillsInfo["available"], skillsInfo["total"])
804: 
805: 	mux := http.NewServeMux()
806: 	mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
807: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
808: 		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
809: 			"status":   "ok",
810: 			"dve_id":   dveID,
811: 			"provider": cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider,
812: 			"model":    cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model,
813: 		})
814: 	})
815: 	mux.HandleFunc("/api/execute", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
816: 		if r.Method != "POST" {
817: 			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
818: 			return
819: 		}
820: 
821: 		var req struct {
822: 			Command string `json:"command"`
823: 		}
824: 		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
825: 			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
826: 				"success": false,
827: 				"error":   "invalid request: " + err.Error(),
828: 			})
829: 			return
830: 		}
831: 
832: 		if req.Command == "" {
833: 			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
834: 				"success": false,
835: 				"error":   "command is required",
836: 			})
837: 			return
838: 		}
839: 
840: 		// Use the HTTP request's context so that if the caller (KNIRVSERVER
841: 		// WebSocket proxy) disconnects or times out, the LLM call is cancelled
842: 		// rather than continuing to consume the server-wide context.
843: 		response, err := agentLoop.ProcessDirect(r.Context(), req.Command, dveID+":terminal")
844: 		if err != nil {
845: 			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
846: 				"success": false,
847: 				"error":   err.Error(),
848: 			})
849: 			return
850: 		}
851: 
852: 		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
853: 			"success": true,
854: 			"output":  response,
855: 		})
856: 	})
857: 
858: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Listening on %s\n", socketPath)
859: 
860: 	// Serve until shutdown signal
861: 	sigChan := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
862: 	signal.Notify(sigChan, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
863: 
864: 	go func() {
865: 		<-sigChan
866: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Shutting down...\n")
867: 		cancel()
868: 		listener.Close()
869: 	}()
870: 
871: 	if err := http.Serve(listener, mux); err != nil {
872: 		if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "use of closed network connection") {
873: 			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Server error: %v\n", err)
874: 		}
875: 	}
876: 
877: 	agentLoop.Stop()
878: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Stopped\n")
879: }

881: // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
882: // Provider fallback — try configured provider first, then fall back through
883: // alternative providers that have API keys configured.  This lets the agent
884: // start even when the default model (gemini-2.0-flash / Gemini) has no key
885: // but other providers (DeepSeek, ShengSuanYun, OpenAI, etc.) do.
886: // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
887: 
888: // providerFallback defines one candidate in the fallback chain.
889: type providerFallback struct {
890: 	Provider string
891: 	Model    string // empty means leave the model at whatever CreateProvider picks
892: }
893: 
894: // defaultFallbackChain is the order of providers to try, from most preferred
895: // to least.  The first entry is always the user-configured provider/model.
896: var defaultFallbackChain = []providerFallback{
897: 	// Entry 0 is a sentinel — filled in at runtime with the configured provider/model.
898: 	{Provider: "", Model: ""},
899: 	{Provider: "deepseek", Model: "deepseek-chat"},
900: 	{Provider: "shengsuanyun", Model: ""},
901: 	{Provider: "openai", Model: "gpt-4o-mini"},
902: 	{Provider: "anthropic", Model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"},
903: 	{Provider: "groq", Model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"},
904: 	// Last resort — use OpenRouter if any key is set.  It proxies many models.
905: 	{Provider: "openrouter", Model: "google/gemini-2.0-flash"},
906: }
907: 
908: // hasAPIKeyFor returns true when the given provider has a non-empty API key
909: // in the config.  This avoids attempting provider creation only to fail again.
910: func hasAPIKeyFor(cfg *config.Config, providerName string) bool {
911: 	switch strings.ToLower(providerName) {
912: 	case "gemini", "google":
913: 		return cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey != ""
914: 	case "deepseek":
915: 		return cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey != ""
916: 	case "shengsuanyun", "cerebras":
917: 		return cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey != ""
918: 	case "openai", "gpt":
919: 		return cfg.Providers.OpenAI.APIKey != "" || cfg.Providers.OpenAI.AuthMethod != ""
920: 	case "anthropic", "claude":
921: 		return cfg.Providers.Anthropic.APIKey != "" || cfg.Providers.Anthropic.AuthMethod != ""
922: 	case "openrouter":
923: 		return cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey != ""
924: 	case "groq":
925: 		return cfg.Providers.Groq.APIKey != ""
926: 	case "vllm":
927: 		return cfg.Providers.VLLM.APIBase != ""
928: 	default:
929: 		return false
930: 	}
931: }
932: 
933: // createProviderWithFallback tries the configured provider first.  If it
934: // fails (e.g. no API key for the default model), it walks the fallback chain
935: // looking for a provider with an available API key.  When a fallback succeeds,
936: // it updates cfg.Agents.Defaults so the rest of the agent (subagent manager,
937: // context builder, etc.) uses the correct provider and model.
938: func createProviderWithFallback(cfg *config.Config) (providers.LLMProvider, error) {
939: 	// Build the chain starting with the user-configured provider/model.
940: 	chain := make([]providerFallback, len(defaultFallbackChain))
941: 	copy(chain, defaultFallbackChain)
942: 	chain[0] = providerFallback{
943: 		Provider: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider,
944: 		Model:    cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model,
945: 	}
946: 
947: 	origProvider := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider
948: 	origModel := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
949: 
950: 	for i, fb := range chain {
951: 		if fb.Provider == "" {
952: 			continue
953: 		}
954: 		if !hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
955: 			continue
956: 		}
957: 
958: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Provider
959: 		if fb.Model != "" {
960: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
961: 		}
962: 
963: 		provider, err := providers.CreateProvider(cfg)
964: 		if err == nil {
965: 			if i > 0 {
966: 				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr,
967: 					"[KNIRVAGENT] Provider %q (model: %q) unavailable, "+
968: 						"falling back to %q (model: %q)\n",
969: 					chain[0].Provider, chain[0].Model,
970: 					fb.Provider, cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model)
971: 			}
972: 			return provider, nil
973: 		}
974: 
975: 		// Restore before trying the next fallback
976: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
977: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
978: 	}
979: 
980: 	// Every provider failed — build a helpful error message
981: 	var available []string
982: 	for _, fb := range chain {
983: 		if fb.Provider != "" && hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
984: 			available = append(available, fb.Provider)
985: 		}
986: 	}
987: 	if len(available) > 0 {
988: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
989: 			"no usable provider: %q has no valid API key (models %q), "+
990: 				"and fallback providers failed. "+
991: 				"Available providers with keys: %v",
992: 			chain[0].Provider, chain[0].Model, available)
993: 	}
994: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf(
995: 		"no API keys configured for any provider. "+
996: 			"Ensure root.key contains at least one API key "+
997: 			"(Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.)")
998: }

1000: // isStartupAuthError returns true when an API call error indicates an
1001: // invalid or missing key (HTTP 400/401/403) rather than a transient failure.
1002: func isStartupAuthError(err error) bool {
1003: 	msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
1004: 	return strings.Contains(msg, "400") ||
1005: 		strings.Contains(msg, "401") ||
1006: 		strings.Contains(msg, "403") ||
1007: 		strings.Contains(msg, "invalid api key") ||
1008: 		strings.Contains(msg, "api key not found") ||
1009: 		strings.Contains(msg, "api_key_invalid") ||
1010: 		strings.Contains(msg, "unauthorized") ||
1011: 		strings.Contains(msg, "permission denied")
1012: }

1014: // validateAndPromoteProvider makes a minimal test call to the primary provider.
1015: // If it fails with an auth error, each fallback is tried in order and the first
1016: // working one is promoted to primary — its entry is removed from the returned
1017: // fallback slice and cfg.Agents.Defaults is updated accordingly.
1018: // Non-auth failures (rate limits, network issues) are logged but do not trigger
1019: // promotion, so the agent still starts and may recover at runtime.
1020: func validateAndPromoteProvider(
1021: 	primary providers.LLMProvider,
1022: 	cfg *config.Config,
1023: 	fallbacks []agent.FallbackEntry,
1024: ) (providers.LLMProvider, []agent.FallbackEntry) {
1025: 	testMsg := []providers.Message{{Role: "user", Content: "reply with: ok"}}
1026: 	testOpts := map[string]interface{}{"max_tokens": 5}
1027: 
1028: 	valCtx, valCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
1029: 	_, primaryErr := primary.Chat(valCtx, testMsg, nil, cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model, testOpts)
1030: 	valCancel()
1031: 
1032: 	if primaryErr == nil {
1033: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Provider %q passed auth validation\n", cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
1034: 		return primary, fallbacks
1035: 	}
1036: 
1037: 	if !isStartupAuthError(primaryErr) {
1038: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Warning: primary provider %q test failed (non-auth, may recover): %v\n",
1039: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider, primaryErr)
1040: 		return primary, fallbacks
1041: 	}
1042: 
1043: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Primary provider %q auth error at startup: %v — testing fallbacks\n",
1044: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider, primaryErr)
1045: 
1046: 	for i, fb := range fallbacks {
1047: 		fbCtx, fbCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
1048: 		_, err := fb.Provider.Chat(fbCtx, testMsg, nil, fb.Model, testOpts)
1049: 		fbCancel()
1050: 
1051: 		if err == nil {
1052: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Name
1053: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
1054: 			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Promoted %q (model: %q) as primary provider\n", fb.Name, fb.Model)
1055: 			// Remove the promoted entry from fallbacks
1056: 			remaining := make([]agent.FallbackEntry, 0, len(fallbacks)-1)
1057: 			remaining = append(remaining, fallbacks[:i]...)
1058: 			remaining = append(remaining, fallbacks[i+1:]...)
1059: 			return fb.Provider, remaining
1060: 		}
1061: 		if isStartupAuthError(err) {
1062: 			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Fallback %q auth error, skipping\n", fb.Name)
1063: 		} else {
1064: 			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Fallback %q test failed (non-auth): %v, skipping\n", fb.Name, err)
1065: 		}
1066: 	}
1067: 
1068: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] No fallback passed auth validation — continuing with %q (may fail at runtime)\n",
1069: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
1070: 	return primary, fallbacks
1071: }

1073: // buildRuntimeFallbacks pre-creates all fallback providers (excluding the
1074: // one already chosen as primary) so the AgentLoop can switch at runtime when
1075: // an auth error occurs.  Providers with no API key are silently skipped.
1076: func buildRuntimeFallbacks(cfg *config.Config) []agent.FallbackEntry {
1077: 	primaryProvider := strings.ToLower(cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
1078: 	origProvider := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider
1079: 	origModel := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
1080: 
1081: 	var entries []agent.FallbackEntry
1082: 	for _, fb := range defaultFallbackChain[1:] {
1083: 		if fb.Provider == "" {
1084: 			continue
1085: 		}
1086: 		if strings.EqualFold(fb.Provider, primaryProvider) {
1087: 			continue // already the primary
1088: 		}
1089: 		if !hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
1090: 			continue
1091: 		}
1092: 
1093: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Provider
1094: 		if fb.Model != "" {
1095: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
1096: 		} else {
1097: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1098: 		}
1099: 
1100: 		p, err := providers.CreateProvider(cfg)
1101: 		if err != nil {
1102: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
1103: 			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1104: 			continue
1105: 		}
1106: 
1107: 		model := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
1108: 		entries = append(entries, agent.FallbackEntry{
1109: 			Provider: p,
1110: 			Model:    model,
1111: 			Name:     fb.Provider,
1112: 		})
1113: 
1114: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
1115: 		cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1116: 	}
1117: 
1118: 	return entries
1119: }

190: type AgentManagerConfig struct {
191: 	BinaryPath      string
192: 	SocketDir       string
193: 	MaxConcurrent   int
194: 	StartTimeout    time.Duration
195: 	StopTimeout     time.Duration
196: 	HealthInterval  time.Duration
197: 	ExtraEnv        []string
198: }
199: 
200: // HealthStatus represents the health status of an agent.
201: type HealthStatus struct {
202: 	Status    string                 `json:"status"`
203: 	Services  map[string]interface{} `json:"services"`
204: 	Timestamp time.Time              `json:"timestamp"`
205: }
206: 
207: // NewAgentManager creates a new AgentManager.
208: func NewAgentManager(cfg *AgentManagerConfig, logger *zap.Logger) *AgentManager {
209: 	if cfg.MaxConcurrent <= 0 {
210: 		cfg.MaxConcurrent = 32
211: 	}
212: 	if cfg.HealthInterval <= 0 {
213: 		cfg.HealthInterval = 30 * time.Second
214: 	}
215: 
216: 	return &AgentManager{
217: 		agents:         make(map[string]*AgentProcess),
218: 		socketDir:      cfg.SocketDir,
219: 		binaryPath:     cfg.BinaryPath,
220: 		maxConcurrent:  cfg.MaxConcurrent,
221: 		logger:         logger,
222: 		healthInterval: cfg.HealthInterval,
223: 		extraEnv:       cfg.ExtraEnv,
224: 	}
225: }
226: 
227: // StartAgent spawns a new KNIRVAGENT subprocess for the given DVE ID.
228: // It blocks until the agent's socket is ready (up to StartTimeout).
229: func (am *AgentManager) StartAgent(ctx context.Context, dveID string, startTimeout time.Duration) (*AgentProcess, error) {
230: 	am.mu.Lock()
231: 
232: 	// Check if already running
233: 	if existing, ok := am.agents[dveID]; ok && existing.isHealthy() {
234: 		am.mu.Unlock()
235: 		am.logger.Info("Agent already running for DVE", zap.String("dveID", dveID))
236: 		return existing, nil
237: 	}
238: 
239: 	// Check max concurrent limit
240: 	if len(am.agents) >= am.maxConcurrent {
241: 		am.mu.Unlock()
242: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("max concurrent agents reached (%d/%d)",
243: 			len(am.agents), am.maxConcurrent)
244: 	}
245: 
246: 	resolvedPath := am.binaryPath
247: 	if resolvedPath == "" {
248: 		var err error
249: 		resolvedPath, err = resolveBinaryPath("./knirvagent")
250: 		if err != nil {
251: 			am.mu.Unlock()
252: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("KNIRVAGENT binary not found: %w", err)
253: 		}
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	if am.socketDir != "" {
257: 		if err := os.MkdirAll(am.socketDir, 0755); err != nil {
258: 			am.mu.Unlock()
259: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create socket dir %s: %w", am.socketDir, err)
260: 		}
261: 	}
262: 
263: 	socketPath := filepath.Join(am.socketDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.sock", dveID))
264: 
265: 	// Kill any stale instance for this DVE
266: 	killStaleAgent(resolvedPath)
267: 	os.Remove(socketPath)
268: 
269: 	am.logger.Info("Starting KNIRVAGENT for DVE",
270: 		zap.String("dveID", dveID),
271: 		zap.String("socket", socketPath),
272: 		zap.String("binary", resolvedPath))
273: 
274: 	// Build command — the agent runs the `server` subcommand which listens
275: 	// on a Unix socket (agent-{dveID}.sock) and exposes POST /api/execute.
276: 	args := []string{
277: 		"server",
278: 		"--dve-id", dveID,
279: 		"--socket-path", socketPath,
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	cmd := exec.Command(resolvedPath, args...)
283: 	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
284: 	cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, am.extraEnv...)
285: 	cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
286: 	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
287: 	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{
288: 		Setpgid: true,
289: 	}
290: 
291: 	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
292: 		am.mu.Unlock()
293: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to start KNIRVAGENT for DVE %s: %w", dveID, err)
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	pid := cmd.Process.Pid
297: 
298: 	ap := &AgentProcess{
299: 		DVEID:      dveID,
300: 		Cmd:        cmd,
301: 		SocketPath: socketPath,
302: 		PID:        pid,
303: 		StartedAt:  time.Now(),
304: 		Healthy:    false,
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	am.agents[dveID] = ap
308: 	am.mu.Unlock()
309: 
310: 	// Wait for the socket to appear (outside the lock)
311: 	if startTimeout <= 0 {
312: 		startTimeout = 30 * time.Second
313: 	}
314: 	if !waitForSocket(socketPath, startTimeout) {
315: 		// Socket didn't appear — kill the process group
316: 		syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
317: 		am.mu.Lock()
318: 		delete(am.agents, dveID)
319: 		am.mu.Unlock()
320: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("timeout waiting for agent socket %s for DVE %s", socketPath, dveID)
321: 	}
322: 
323: 	ap.setHealthy(true)
324: 
325: 	am.logger.Info("KNIRVAGENT started for DVE",
326: 		zap.String("dveID", dveID),
327: 		zap.Int("pid", pid),
328: 		zap.String("socket", socketPath))
329: 
330: 	return ap, nil
331: }
332: 
333: // StopAgent stops the agent subprocess for the given DVE ID.
334: func (am *AgentManager) StopAgent(dveID string, stopTimeout time.Duration) error {
335: 	am.mu.Lock()
336: 	ap, ok := am.agents[dveID]
337: 	if !ok {
338: 		am.mu.Unlock()
339: 		return nil // idempotent — already stopped
340: 	}
341: 	delete(am.agents, dveID)
342: 	am.mu.Unlock()
343: 
344: 	if ap.Cmd == nil || ap.Cmd.Process == nil {
345: 		os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
346: 		return nil
347: 	}
348: 
349: 	am.logger.Info("Stopping KNIRVAGENT for DVE",
350: 		zap.String("dveID", dveID),
351: 		zap.Int("pid", ap.PID))
352: 
353: 	// Send SIGTERM
354: 	if err := ap.Cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM); err != nil {
355: 		am.logger.Warn("Failed to send SIGTERM to agent, forcing kill",
356: 			zap.String("dveID", dveID),
357: 			zap.Error(err))
358: 		syscall.Kill(-ap.Cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
359: 	}
360: 
361: 	done := make(chan error, 1)
362: 	go func() {
363: 		done <- ap.Cmd.Wait()
364: 	}()
365: 
366: 	if stopTimeout <= 0 {
367: 		stopTimeout = 10 * time.Second
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	select {
371: 	case <-done:
372: 		ap.setHealthy(false)
373: 		os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
374: 		am.logger.Info("KNIRVAGENT stopped for DVE", zap.String("dveID", dveID))
375: 		return nil
376: 	case <-time.After(stopTimeout):
377: 		am.logger.Warn("Timeout waiting for agent shutdown, forcing kill",
378: 			zap.String("dveID", dveID))
379: 		syscall.Kill(-ap.Cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
380: 		ap.setHealthy(false)
381: 		os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
382: 		return fmt.Errorf("forced shutdown of agent for DVE %s after timeout", dveID)
383: 	}
384: }
385: 
386: // GetAgent returns the agent process for a DVE, or an error if not running.
387: func (am *AgentManager) GetAgent(dveID string) (*AgentProcess, error) {
388: 	am.mu.RLock()
389: 	defer am.mu.RUnlock()
390: 
391: 	ap, ok := am.agents[dveID]
392: 	if !ok {
393: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no agent running for DVE %s", dveID)
394: 	}
395: 	return ap, nil
396: }
397: 
398: // ListAgents returns all running agent processes.
399: func (am *AgentManager) ListAgents() []*AgentProcess {
400: 	am.mu.RLock()
401: 	defer am.mu.RUnlock()
402: 
403: 	result := make([]*AgentProcess, 0, len(am.agents))
404: 	for _, ap := range am.agents {
405: 		result = append(result, ap)
406: 	}
407: 	return result
408: }
409: 
410: // RunningCount returns the number of running agents.
411: func (am *AgentManager) RunningCount() int {
412: 	am.mu.RLock()
413: 	defer am.mu.RUnlock()
414: 	return len(am.agents)
415: }
416: 
417: // MaxConcurrent returns the max concurrent agents limit.
418: func (am *AgentManager) MaxConcurrent() int {
419: 	return am.maxConcurrent
420: }
421: 
422: // StopAll stops every agent process in parallel with a global timeout.
423: func (am *AgentManager) StopAll(ctx context.Context) error {
424: 	am.mu.RLock()
425: 	dveIDs := make([]string, 0, len(am.agents))
426: 	for dveID := range am.agents {
427: 		dveIDs = append(dveIDs, dveID)
428: 	}
429: 	am.mu.RUnlock()
430: 
431: 	if len(dveIDs) == 0 {
432: 		return nil
433: 	}
434: 
435: 	am.logger.Info("Stopping all KNIRVAGENT processes", zap.Int("count", len(dveIDs)))
436: 
437: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
438: 	errCh := make(chan error, len(dveIDs))
439: 
440: 	for _, dveID := range dveIDs {
441: 		wg.Add(1)
442: 		go func(id string) {
443: 			defer wg.Done()
444: 			if err := am.StopAgent(id, 10*time.Second); err != nil {
445: 				errCh <- err
446: 			}
447: 		}(dveID)
448: 	}
449: 
450: 	doneCh := make(chan struct{})
451: 	go func() {
452: 		wg.Wait()
453: 		close(doneCh)
454: 	}()
455: 
456: 	select {
457: 	case <-doneCh:
458: 		close(errCh)
459: 		// Collect any errors
460: 		var errs []error
461: 		for err := range errCh {
462: 			errs = append(errs, err)
463: 		}
464: 		if len(errs) > 0 {
465: 			return fmt.Errorf("errors stopping agents: %v", errs)
466: 		}
467: 		return nil
468: 	case <-ctx.Done():
469: 		return fmt.Errorf("timeout stopping all agents: %w", ctx.Err())
470: 	case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
471: 		return fmt.Errorf("timeout stopping all agents after 15s")
472: 	}
473: }
474: 
475: // HealthCheck pings the agent's socket for the given DVE.
476: func (am *AgentManager) HealthCheck(dveID string) bool {
477: 	ap, err := am.GetAgent(dveID)
478: 	if err != nil {
479: 		return false
480: 	}
481: 
482: 	client := &http.Client{
483: 		Timeout: 3 * time.Second,
484: 		Transport: &http.Transport{
485: 			DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
486: 				return net.DialTimeout("unix", ap.SocketPath, 2*time.Second)
487: 			},
488: 		},
489: 	}
490: 
491: 	resp, err := client.Get("http://localhost/health")
492: 	if err != nil {
493: 		ap.setHealthy(false)
494: 		return false
495: 	}
496: 	defer resp.Body.Close()
497: 
498: 	healthy := resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK
499: 	ap.setHealthy(healthy)
500: 	return healthy
501: }
502: 
503: // GetHealthStatus returns the full health status payload from an agent.
504: func (am *AgentManager) GetHealthStatus(ctx context.Context, dveID string) (*HealthStatus, error) {
505: 	ap, err := am.GetAgent(dveID)
506: 	if err != nil {
507: 		return nil, err
508: 	}
509: 
510: 	client := &http.Client{
511: 		Timeout: 5 * time.Second,
512: 		Transport: &http.Transport{
513: 			DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
514: 				return net.DialTimeout("unix", ap.SocketPath, 2*time.Second)
515: 			},
516: 		},
517: 	}
518: 
519: 	resp, err := client.Get("http://localhost/health")
520: 	if err != nil {
521: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("agent %s health check failed: %w", dveID, err)
522: 	}
523: 	defer resp.Body.Close()
524: 
525: 	var status HealthStatus
526: 	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&status); err != nil {
527: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode health status: %w", err)
528: 	}
529: 
530: 	ap.setHealthy(resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK)
531: 	return &status, nil
532: }
533: 
534: // StartPeriodicHealthCheck starts a goroutine that periodically checks
535: // all agents and reaps any that are unhealthy.
536: func (am *AgentManager) StartPeriodicHealthCheck(ctx context.Context) {
537: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
538: 	am.stopHealthCheck = cancel
539: 
540: 	am.wg.Add(1)
541: 	go func() {
542: 		defer am.wg.Done()
543: 		ticker := time.NewTicker(am.healthInterval)
544: 		defer ticker.Stop()
545: 
546: 		for {
547: 			select {
548: 			case <-ctx.Done():
549: 				return
550: 			case <-ticker.C:
551: 				am.reapUnhealthy()
552: 			}
553: 		}
554: 	}()
555: 
556: 	am.logger.Info("Periodic agent health check started",
557: 		zap.Duration("interval", am.healthInterval))
558: }
559: 
560: // StopPeriodicHealthCheck stops the periodic health check goroutine.
561: func (am *AgentManager) StopPeriodicHealthCheck() {
562: 	if am.stopHealthCheck != nil {
563: 		am.stopHealthCheck()
564: 	}
565: 	am.wg.Wait()
566: }
567: 
568: // reapUnhealthy checks all agents and removes any whose process has exited
569: // or whose socket is gone.
570: func (am *AgentManager) reapUnhealthy() {
571: 	am.mu.RLock()
572: 	snapshot := make([]*AgentProcess, 0, len(am.agents))
573: 	for _, ap := range am.agents {
574: 		snapshot = append(snapshot, ap)
575: 	}
576: 	am.mu.RUnlock()
577: 
578: 	for _, ap := range snapshot {
579: 		// Check if socket still exists
580: 		if _, err := os.Stat(ap.SocketPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
581: 			am.logger.Warn("Agent socket missing, reaping",
582: 				zap.String("dveID", ap.DVEID),
583: 				zap.String("socket", ap.SocketPath))
584: 			am.mu.Lock()
585: 			// Re-check inside lock to avoid race
586: 			if existing, ok := am.agents[ap.DVEID]; ok && existing.SocketPath == ap.SocketPath {
587: 				delete(am.agents, ap.DVEID)
588: 			}
589: 			am.mu.Unlock()
590: 			continue
591: 		}
592: 
593: 		// Check if process is still alive
594: 		if ap.Cmd != nil && ap.Cmd.Process != nil {
595: 			if err := ap.Cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.Signal(0)); err != nil {
596: 				// Process is gone
597: 				am.logger.Warn("Agent process exited, reaping",
598: 					zap.String("dveID", ap.DVEID),
599: 					zap.Int("pid", ap.PID))
600: 				ap.setHealthy(false)
601: 				os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
602: 				am.mu.Lock()
603: 				if existing, ok := am.agents[ap.DVEID]; ok && existing.PID == ap.PID {
604: 					delete(am.agents, ap.DVEID)
605: 				}
606: 				am.mu.Unlock()
607: 			}
608: 		}
609: 	}
610: }
611: 
612: // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
613: // Legacy backward-compatible types (for main.go)
614: // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
615: 
616: // ManagerConfig is the legacy config type. New code should use AgentManagerConfig.
617: type ManagerConfig struct {
618: 	BinaryPath     string
619: 	SocketPath     string
620: 	Port           int
621: 	BackendAPIPort int
622: 	StartTimeout   time.Duration
623: 	StopTimeout    time.Duration
624: 	Stdout         io.Writer
625: 	Stderr         io.Writer
626: 	ExtraEnv       []string
627: }
628: 
629: // Manager is the legacy manager type. New code should use AgentManager.
630: type Manager struct {
631: 	inner *AgentManager
632: 	logger *zap.Logger
633: 	cfg    *ManagerConfig
634: }
635: 
636: // DefaultManagerConfig returns a legacy ManagerConfig with sensible defaults.
637: func DefaultManagerConfig() *ManagerConfig {
638: 	return &ManagerConfig{
639: 		SocketPath:   "",
640: 		Port:         8080,
641: 		StartTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
642: 		StopTimeout:  10 * time.Second,
643: 	}
644: }
645: 
646: // NewManager creates a legacy Manager wrapping the new AgentManager.
647: func NewManager(cfg *ManagerConfig, logger *zap.Logger) *Manager {
648: 	socketDir := ""
649: 	if cfg.SocketPath != "" {
650: 		socketDir = filepath.Dir(cfg.SocketPath)
651: 	}
652: 	if socketDir == "" {
653: 		// Fall back to a stable app-data directory so that socket files are
654: 		// never created in the process CWD, which may not be writable.
655: 		socketDir = filepath.Join(getAgentAppDataDir(), "sockets")
656: 	}
657: 
658: 	innerCfg := &AgentManagerConfig{
659: 		BinaryPath:     cfg.BinaryPath,
660: 		SocketDir:      socketDir,
661: 		MaxConcurrent:  32,
662: 		StartTimeout:   cfg.StartTimeout,
663: 		StopTimeout:    cfg.StopTimeout,
664: 		HealthInterval: 30 * time.Second,
665: 		ExtraEnv:       cfg.ExtraEnv,
666: 	}
667: 
668: 	inner := NewAgentManager(innerCfg, logger)
669: 	return &Manager{inner: inner, logger: logger, cfg: cfg}
670: }
671: 
672: // StartAgent delegates per-DVE agent start to the inner AgentManager.
673: func (m *Manager) StartAgent(ctx context.Context, dveID string, startTimeout time.Duration) error {
674: 	_, err := m.inner.StartAgent(ctx, dveID, startTimeout)
675: 	return err
676: }
677: 
678: // RunningCount returns the number of running agents.
679: func (m *Manager) RunningCount() int {
680: 	return m.inner.RunningCount()
681: }
682: 
683: // GetSocketPathForDVE returns the Unix socket path for the agent of a specific DVE.
684: func (m *Manager) GetSocketPathForDVE(dveID string) (string, error) {
685: 	ap, err := m.inner.GetAgent(dveID)
686: 	if err != nil {
687: 		return "", err
688: 	}
689: 	return ap.SocketPath, nil
690: }
691: 
692: // Start starts the agent manager. In the new multi-DVE model, this is a no-op
693: // that just logs — agents are started per-DVE via StartAgent.
694: func (m *Manager) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
695: 	m.logger.Info("KNIRVAGENT legacy Start called (delegating to per-DVE StartAgent)")
696: 	return nil
697: }
698: 
699: // Stop stops all running agents.
700: func (m *Manager) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
701: 	return m.inner.StopAll(ctx)
702: }
703: 
704: // IsRunning returns true if any agents are running.
705: func (m *Manager) IsRunning() bool {
706: 	return m.inner.RunningCount() > 0
707: }
708: 
709: // GetBaseURL returns a legacy base URL stub.
710: func (m *Manager) GetBaseURL() string {
711: 	return "http://localhost"
712: }
713: 
714: // GetConfig returns the legacy config.
715: func (m *Manager) GetConfig() *ManagerConfig {
716: 	return m.cfg
717: }
718: 
719: // HealthCheck checks if any agent is healthy.
720: func (m *Manager) HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error {
721: 	agents := m.inner.ListAgents()
722: 	if len(agents) == 0 {
723: 		return fmt.Errorf("no agents running")
724: 	}
725: 	for _, ap := range agents {
726: 		if m.inner.HealthCheck(ap.DVEID) {
727: 			return nil
728: 		}
729: 	}
730: 	return fmt.Errorf("no healthy agents")
731: }
732: 
733: // GetHealthStatus returns health status of a specific agent.
734: func (m *Manager) GetHealthStatus(ctx context.Context) (*HealthStatus, error) {
735: 	agents := m.inner.ListAgents()
736: 	if len(agents) == 0 {
737: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no agents running")
738: 	}
739: 	return m.inner.GetHealthStatus(ctx, agents[0].DVEID)
740: }
741: 
742: // GetPID returns the PID of the first running agent.
743: func (m *Manager) GetPID() int {
744: 	agents := m.inner.ListAgents()
745: 	if len(agents) == 0 {
746: 		return 0
747: 	}
748: 	return agents[0].PID
749: }

64: // New creates a new HTTP server
65: func New(cfg *config.Config, webguiStaticDir, graphChainExplorerDir, knirvChainPortalDir string, logger *zap.Logger, db ...*sql.DB) (*Server, error) {
66: 	var dbInstance *sql.DB
67: 	if len(db) > 0 {
68: 		dbInstance = db[0]
69: 	}
70: 	// Initialize operator service.
71: 	// Oracle is only accessible through the gateway's Unix socket reverse proxy;
72: 	// the independent TCP port (1317) has been removed.
73: 	oracleBaseURL := "http://localhost:1317"
74: 	if cfg.OracleSocketPath != "" {
75: 		oracleBaseURL = "http://knirvoracle" // proxied via socket
76: 	}
77: 	operatorSvc := operator.NewService(logger, oracleBaseURL)
78: 	operatorSvc.Initialize() // Load mock data
79: 
80: 	operatorHdlr := operator.NewHandler(operatorSvc, logger)
81: 
82: 	// Initialize tunnel service
83: 	tunnelConfig := &tunnel.Config{
84: 		HTTPAPIPort:         cfg.TunnelRegistryHTTPPort,
85: 		ControlListenerPort: cfg.TunnelRegistryControlPort,
86: 		PublicRelayPort:     cfg.TunnelRegistryRelayPort,
87: 		STUNPort:            cfg.TunnelRegistrySTUNPort,
88: 		ServerPublicHost:    cfg.PublicHost,
89: 		RelayServerPeerID:   cfg.InternalAPIKey, // Using internal API key as peer ID for now
90: 	}
91: 	tunnelSvc := tunnel.NewService(tunnelConfig, logger)
92: 	tunnelHdlr := tunnelSvc.GetHandler()
93: 
94: 	// Initialize payment service
95: 	paymentConfig := &payment.Config{
96: 		StripeSecretKey:     "", // Will be set from environment
97: 		CoinbaseAPIKey:      "", // Will be set from environment
98: 		FaucetCooldownHours: 24,
99: 		DefaultNetwork:      "mainnet",
100: 		EconomicsEnabled:    true,
101: 	}
102: 	paymentSvc := payment.NewService(paymentConfig, logger)
103: 	paymentHdlr := payment.NewHandler(paymentSvc, logger)
104: 
105: 	// Initialize auth handler
106: 	authHdlr := auth.NewHandler(cfg, logger, dbInstance)
107: 
108: 	// Initialize URI handler
109: 	uriHdlr := uri.NewHandler(logger)
110: 
111: 	// Initialize explorer handler.
112: 	explorerHandler := webgui.NewHandler(cfg, logger, cfg.Port)
113: 
114: 	// Initialize TURN server with blockchain integration
115: 	var turnSvc *turnserver.Server
116: 	if cfg.TurnServerEnabled {
117: 		turnConfig := &turnserver.TurnServerConfig{
118: 			UDPPort:      cfg.TurnServerUDPPort,
119: 			TCPPort:      cfg.TurnServerTCPPort,
120: 			APIPort:      cfg.TurnServerAPIPort,
121: 			Realm:        cfg.TurnServerRealm,
122: 			AuthSecret:   cfg.TurnServerAuthSecret,
123: 			PublicIP:     cfg.PublicHost,
124: 			MinerAddress: cfg.TurnServerMinerAddress,
125: 		}
126: 
127: 		blockchainAdapter := turnserver.NewBlockchainAdapter(nil, cfg.TurnServerMinerAddress)
128: 		var err error
129: 		turnSvc, err = turnserver.NewServer(turnConfig, blockchainAdapter, logger)
130: 		if err != nil {
131: 			logger.Warn("Failed to initialize TURN server",
132: 				zap.Error(err),
133: 				zap.Int("udp_port", cfg.TurnServerUDPPort),
134: 				zap.Int("tcp_port", cfg.TurnServerTCPPort))
135: 		} else {
136: 			logger.Info("TURN server initialized",
137: 				zap.Int("udp_port", cfg.TurnServerUDPPort),
138: 				zap.Int("tcp_port", cfg.TurnServerTCPPort),
139: 				zap.Int("api_port", cfg.TurnServerAPIPort),
140: 				zap.String("realm", cfg.TurnServerRealm))
141: 		}
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	// Initialize DHT manager if not disabled
145: 	var dhtMgr *dht.DHTManager
146: 	if !cfg.DisableDHT {
147: 		dhtConfig := &dht.Config{
148: 			ServiceID:             "knirvgateway",
149: 			ChainID:               cfg.ChainID,
150: 			BootstrapPeers:        cfg.BootstrapPeers,
151: 			EnableAutoRelay:       false,
152: 			Port:                  cfg.DHTPort,
153: 			AnnounceInterval:      5 * time.Minute,
154: 			NodeRole:              cfg.ChainNodeRole,
155: 			ChainP2PPort:          cfg.ChainP2PPort,
156: 			ChainClientOnly:       cfg.ChainClientOnly,
157: 			ChainIsBootnode:       cfg.ChainIsBootnode,
158: 			ChainBootnodeRegistry: cfg.ChainBootnodeRegistry,
159: 			ChainCallbackSocket:   cfg.ChainCallbackSocket,
160: 		}
161: 		var err error
162: 		dhtMgr, err = dht.NewDHTManager(dhtConfig)
163: 		if err != nil {
164: 			logger.Warn("Failed to initialize DHT manager", zap.Error(err))
165: 		} else {
166: 			logger.Info("DHT manager initialized", zap.Int("port", cfg.DHTPort))
167: 		}
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	s := &Server{
171: 		config:               cfg,
172: 		sessionManager:       session.NewManager(cfg.SessionSecret),
173: 		proxyHandler:         proxy.NewHandler(logger),
174: 		authHandler:          authHdlr,
175: 		operatorService:      operatorSvc,
176: 		operatorHandler:      operatorHdlr,
177: 		tunnelService:        tunnelSvc,
178: 		tunnelHandler:        tunnelHdlr,
179: 		paymentService:       paymentSvc,
180: 		paymentHandler:       paymentHdlr,
181: 		uriHandler:           uriHdlr,
182: 		webguiHandler:        explorerHandler,
183: 		turnServer:           turnSvc,
184: 		dhtManager:          dhtMgr,
185: 		logger:               logger,
186: 		webguiStaticDir:      webguiStaticDir,
187: 		graphChainExplorerDir: graphChainExplorerDir,
188: 		knirvChainPortalDir:  knirvChainPortalDir,
189: 	}
190: 
191: 	if err := s.setupRoutes(); err != nil {
192: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to setup routes: %w", err)
193: 	}
194: 
195: 	return s, nil
196: }

198: // setupRoutes configures all HTTP routes
199: func (s *Server) setupRoutes() error {
200: 	r := mux.NewRouter()
201: 
202: 	// Register MIME types explicitly (important on systems missing /etc/mime.types)
203: 	mime.AddExtensionType(".js", "application/javascript")
204: 	mime.AddExtensionType(".css", "text/css")
205: 	mime.AddExtensionType(".mjs", "application/javascript")
206: 	mime.AddExtensionType(".json", "application/json")
207: 	mime.AddExtensionType(".svg", "image/svg+xml")
208: 	mime.AddExtensionType(".wasm", "application/wasm")
209: 
210: 	// Session endpoints
211: 	r.HandleFunc("/session/controller", s.handleGetSession).Methods("GET")
212: 	r.HandleFunc("/session/controller", s.handleSetSession).Methods("POST")
213: 
214: 	// Health and status endpoints
215: 	r.HandleFunc("/health", s.handleHealth).Methods("GET")
216: 
217: 	// DHT/P2P endpoints (real implementation)
218: 	r.HandleFunc("/dht/announce", s.handleDHTAnnounce).Methods("POST")
219: 	r.HandleFunc("/dht/find", s.handleDHTFind).Methods("GET")
220: 	r.HandleFunc("/dht/peers", s.handleDHTPeers).Methods("GET")
221: 	r.HandleFunc("/dht/bootstrap", s.handleDHTBootstrap).Methods("POST")
222: 
223: 	// Resource Broadcast System endpoints
224: 	r.HandleFunc("/dht/cache-resource", s.handleCacheResource).Methods("POST")
225: 	r.HandleFunc("/dht/announce-all-cached", s.handleAnnounceAllCached).Methods("POST")
226: 	r.HandleFunc("/dht/cache-status", s.handleCacheStatus).Methods("GET")
227: 
228: 	// Chain P2P proxy endpoints (used by KNIRVCHAIN via unix socket)
229: 	r.HandleFunc("/p2p/publish-block", s.handleP2PPublishBlock).Methods("POST")
230: 	r.HandleFunc("/p2p/publish-tx", s.handleP2PPublishTx).Methods("POST")
231: 	r.HandleFunc("/p2p/register-callback", s.handleP2PRegisterCallback).Methods("POST")
232: 	r.HandleFunc("/p2p/peers", s.handleP2PPeers).Methods("GET")
233: 	r.HandleFunc("/p2p/self-addrs", s.handleP2PSelfAddrs).Methods("GET")
234: 	r.HandleFunc("/p2p/peer-id", s.handleP2PPeerID).Methods("GET")
235: 
236: 	// Register auth routes directly
237: 	s.authHandler.RegisterRoutes(r)
238: 
239: 	// Register operator registry routes directly
240: 	if s.operatorHandler != nil {
241: 		s.operatorHandler.RegisterRoutes(r)
242: 	}
243: 
244: 	// Register tunnel registry routes directly
245: 	s.tunnelHandler.RegisterRoutes(r)
246: 
247: 	// Register payment oracle routes directly
248: 	s.paymentHandler.RegisterRoutes(r)
249: 
250: 	// Register URI generation routes directly
251: 	s.uriHandler.RegisterRoutes(r)
252: 
253: 	// Register explorer API routes directly.
254: 	s.webguiHandler.RegisterRoutes(r)
255: 
256: 	// Register TURN server routes (blockchain-enabled)
257: 	if s.turnServer != nil {
258: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/turn/status", s.handleTurnStatus).Methods("GET")
259: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/turn/stats", s.handleTurnStats).Methods("GET")
260: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/proof/submit", s.handleTurnProofSubmit).Methods("POST")
261: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/proof/status", s.handleTurnProofStatus).Methods("GET")
262: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/mint/nrn", s.handleTurnMintNRN).Methods("POST")
263: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/mint/reward", s.handleTurnMintReward).Methods("POST")
264: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/stats/minting", s.handleTurnMintingStats).Methods("GET")
265: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/turn/health", s.handleTurnHealth).Methods("GET")
266: 	}
267: 
268: 	// Dynamic controller proxy
269: 	r.PathPrefix("/controller").Handler(s.handleControllerProxy())
270: 
271: 	// Network monitor API routes — these replace Next.js API routes that are
272: 	// excluded from the static export.  They return static/mock status data
273: 	// for the network-monitor UI page.
274: 	r.HandleFunc("/api/network-monitor/status", s.handleNetworkMonitorStatus).Methods("GET")
275: 	r.HandleFunc("/api/network-monitor/services", s.handleNetworkMonitorServices).Methods("GET")
276: 	r.HandleFunc("/api/network-monitor/metrics", s.handleNetworkMonitorMetrics).Methods("GET")
277: 	r.HandleFunc("/api/network-monitor/logs", s.handleNetworkMonitorLogs).Methods("GET")
278: 	r.HandleFunc("/api/network-monitor/config", s.handleNetworkMonitorConfig).Methods("GET")
279: 
280: 	// Backend reverse proxy — proxy all /api/v1/* to the backend Unix socket
281: 	// (including /api/v1/info, which was previously handled locally by the gateway).
282: 	if s.config.BackendSocketPath != "" {
283: 		backendProxy := newSocketProxy(s.config.BackendSocketPath, "http://knirvserver")
284: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/v1/").Handler(backendProxy)
285: 		s.logger.Info("Backend proxy registered", zap.String("socket", s.config.BackendSocketPath))
286: 	} else {
287: 		s.logger.Warn("Backend proxy not configured — /api/v1/* will not be proxied")
288: 	}
289: 
290: 	// === PHASES 1-4: Unified Proxy Architecture ===
291: 	//
292: 	// Oracle proxy — KNIRVORACLE communicates exclusively via Unix socket
293: 	// through the gateway.  The independent TCP port (historically 1317) is
294: 	// removed; all oracle traffic flows through the gateway's reverse-proxy layer.
295: 	var oracleProxy *httputil.ReverseProxy
296: 	if s.config.OracleSocketPath != "" {
297: 		oracleProxy = newSocketProxy(s.config.OracleSocketPath, "http://knirvoracle")
298: 		s.logger.Info("Oracle proxy registered (socket)", zap.String("socket", s.config.OracleSocketPath))
299: 	} else {
300: 		s.logger.Warn("Oracle socket path not configured — oracle endpoints will not be proxied")
301: 	}
302: 
303: 	// /api/oracle/* — Standardized oracle prefix for all Cosmos blockchain queries
304: 	// Wallet/balance, transaction submission, blocks, staking, governance, IBC.
305: 	// Strip /api prefix so /api/oracle/v3/... becomes /oracle/v3/..., matching the
306: 	// oracle's native route format (oracle serves under /oracle/v3/*).
307: 	if oracleProxy != nil {
308: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/oracle/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/api", oracleProxy))
309: 
310: 		// Root-level wallet-server compatible routes — proxied directly to the oracle
311: 		// without path stripping, matching the oracle's root-level route registrations
312: 		// (/generate_wallet, /balance/{addr}, /send_signed_txn, etc.).
313: 		r.HandleFunc("/generate_wallet", oracleProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "POST", "OPTIONS")
314: 		r.HandleFunc("/balance/", oracleProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
315: 		r.HandleFunc("/send_signed_txn", oracleProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
316: 		r.HandleFunc("/transactions", oracleProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
317: 		r.HandleFunc("/test/faucet", oracleProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
318: 	}
319: 
320: 	// 301 redirects from old flat paths — wallet info and transaction submission
321: 	// routes to the oracle's wallet status and transaction endpoints.
322: 	r.HandleFunc("/wallet/info", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
323: 		http.Redirect(w, r, "/api/oracle/v3/wallet/status", http.StatusMovedPermanently)
324: 	}).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
325: 	r.HandleFunc("/transaction", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
326: 		http.Redirect(w, r, "/transactions", http.StatusMovedPermanently)
327: 	}).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
328: 
329: 	// Chain proxy — KNIRVCHAIN via chain.sock
330: 	if s.config.ChainSocketPath != "" {
331: 		chainProxy := newSocketProxy(s.config.ChainSocketPath, "http://knirvchain")
332: 
333: 		// /api/chain/* — Standardized chain prefix (Phase 2).
334: 		// Strip /api/chain prefix so /api/chain/chain becomes /chain,
335: 		// matching KNIRVCHAIN's native route format.
336: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/chain/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/api/chain", chainProxy))
337: 
338: 		// Flat /chain/* redirect → /api/chain/* (Phase 2)
339: 		r.PathPrefix("/chain/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/chain",
340: 			http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
341: 				http.Redirect(w, r, "/api/chain"+r.URL.Path, http.StatusMovedPermanently)
342: 			})))
343: 
344: 		// /chain (GET) redirect → /api/chain/chain (the actual chain endpoint)
345: 		r.HandleFunc("/chain", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
346: 			http.Redirect(w, r, "/api/chain/chain", http.StatusMovedPermanently)
347: 		}).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
348: 
349: 		// /bootnodes redirect → /api/chain/bootnodes (Phase 2, replaces /devs)
350: 		r.HandleFunc("/bootnodes", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
351: 			http.Redirect(w, r, "/api/chain/bootnodes", http.StatusMovedPermanently)
352: 		}).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
353: 
354: 		// /api/objects → chain proxy (Phase 4 — replaces mock handler)
355: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/objects", chainProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
356: 
357: 		// /api/assets → chain proxy (Phase 4 — replaces mock handler)
358: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/assets", chainProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
359: 
360: 		// WebGUI flat paths — proxy directly to chain.sock (these are the
361: 		// actual endpoints KNIRVCHAIN serves at root level).
362: 		r.HandleFunc("/txn_pool", chainProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
363: 		r.HandleFunc("/devs", chainProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
364: 
365: 		s.logger.Info("Chain proxy registered", zap.String("socket", s.config.ChainSocketPath))
366: 	} else {
367: 		s.logger.Warn("Chain proxy not configured — /api/chain/* will not be proxied")
368: 
369: 		// Fallback: return empty data for chain endpoints when chain is not available
370: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/objects", s.handleEmptyArray).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
371: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/assets", s.handleEmptyArray).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
372: 
373: 		// /chain fallback — WebGUI still calls this endpoint directly.
374: 		// Return empty data instead of 404 so the dashboard doesn't break.
375: 		r.HandleFunc("/chain", s.handleEmptyArray).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
376: 
377: 		// WebGUI flat path fallbacks when chain socket isn't available.
378: 		r.HandleFunc("/txn_pool", s.handleEmptyArray).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
379: 		r.HandleFunc("/devs", s.handleEmptyArray).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
380: 		r.HandleFunc("/wallet/info", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
381: 			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
382: 			w.Write([]byte("{}\n"))
383: 		}).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
384: 		r.HandleFunc("/transaction", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
385: 			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
386: 			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
387: 			w.Write([]byte(`{"error":"chain not available"}` + "\n"))
388: 		}).Methods("POST", "OPTIONS")
389: 	}
390: 
391: 	// Graph proxy — KNIRVGRAPH via graph.sock (Phase 3)
392: 	if s.config.GraphSocketPath != "" {
393: 		graphProxy := newSocketProxy(s.config.GraphSocketPath, "http://knirvgraph")
394: 
395: 		// /api/graph/* — Standardized graph prefix.
396: 		// Strip /api/graph so /api/graph/* becomes /* on KNIRVGRAPH.
397: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/graph/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/api/graph", graphProxy))
398: 
399: 		// Flat /graph/* redirect → /api/graph/*
400: 		r.PathPrefix("/graph/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/graph",
401: 			http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
402: 				http.Redirect(w, r, "/api/graph"+r.URL.Path, http.StatusMovedPermanently)
403: 			})))
404: 
405: 		s.logger.Info("Graph proxy registered", zap.String("socket", s.config.GraphSocketPath))
406: 	} else {
407: 		s.logger.Warn("Graph proxy not configured — /api/graph/* will not be proxied")
408: 	}
409: 
410: 	// Shell proxy — KNIRVSHELL via shell.sock (Phase 5)
411: 	if s.config.ShellSocketPath != "" {
412: 		shellProxy := newSocketProxy(s.config.ShellSocketPath, "http://knirvshell")
413: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/shell/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/api/shell", shellProxy))
414: 		// 307 (method-preserving) redirects from old shell paths
415: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/v1/shell/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/api/v1/shell",
416: 			http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
417: 				http.Redirect(w, r, "/api/shell"+r.URL.Path, http.StatusTemporaryRedirect)
418: 			})))
419: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/knirvshell/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/api/knirvshell",
420: 			http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
421: 				http.Redirect(w, r, "/api/shell"+r.URL.Path, http.StatusTemporaryRedirect)
422: 			})))
423: 		s.logger.Info("Shell proxy registered", zap.String("socket", s.config.ShellSocketPath))
424: 	} else {
425: 		s.logger.Warn("Shell proxy not configured — /api/shell/* will not be proxied")
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	// Hasher proxy — KNIRVHASHER via Unix socket (Phase 8)
429: 	if s.config.HasherSocketPath != "" {
430: 		hasherProxy := newSocketProxy(s.config.HasherSocketPath, "http://knirvhasher")
431: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/knirvhasher/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/api/knirvhasher", hasherProxy))
432: 
433: 		s.logger.Info("Hasher proxy registered", zap.String("socket", s.config.HasherSocketPath))
434: 	} else {
435: 		s.logger.Warn("Hasher socket path not configured — /api/knirvhasher/* will not be proxied")
436: 	}
437: 
438: 	// Agent proxy — KNIRVAGENT per-DVE dynamic socket proxy (Phase 6)
439: 	if s.config.AgentSocketDir != "" {
440: 		r.PathPrefix("/api/agent/").Handler(s.dynamicAgentProxy())
441: 		s.logger.Info("Agent proxy registered", zap.String("socketDir", s.config.AgentSocketDir))
442: 	} else {
443: 		s.logger.Warn("Agent proxy not configured — /api/agent/* will not be proxied")
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	// Phase 4: Replace WebGUI mock endpoints with real proxy destinations.
447: 	// /api/transactions → oracle proxy (Cosmos tx history)
448: 	if oracleProxy != nil {
449: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/transactions", oracleProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
450: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/blocks", oracleProxy.ServeHTTP).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
451: 	} else {
452: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/transactions", s.handleEmptyArray).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
453: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/blocks", s.handleEmptyArray).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
454: 	}
455: 
456: 	// NOTE: No catch-all mock handler. Unmatched /api/* routes will 404
457: 	// instead of returning fake data, forcing real endpoint implementation.
458: 
459: 	// /api/v1/info fallback when backend proxy isn't configured
460: 	if s.config.BackendSocketPath == "" {
461: 		r.HandleFunc("/api/v1/info", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
462: 			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
463: 			w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"ok","mode":"gateway","role":"General","network":"local"}` + "\n"))
464: 		}).Methods("GET", "OPTIONS")
465: 	}
466: 
467: 	// IMPORTANT: Next.js static export uses absolute paths like /_next/..., /favicon.ico, etc.
468: 	// These are served at the root level so the explorer can load its assets.
469: 
470: 	// Serve Next.js _next directory (contains JS, CSS, chunks, etc.)
471: 	r.PathPrefix("/_next/").Handler(http.StripPrefix("/", http.FileServer(http.Dir(s.webguiStaticDir))))
472: 
473: 	// Serve explorer static files at the root level (favicon, svgs, etc.).
474: 	webguiStaticFiles := []string{"/favicon.ico", "/next.svg", "/window.svg", "/globe.svg", "/vercel.svg", "/file.svg"}
475: 	for _, staticFile := range webguiStaticFiles {
476: 		filePath := staticFile
477: 		r.HandleFunc(filePath, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
478: 			fullPath := filepath.Join(s.webguiStaticDir, filePath)
479: 			s.logger.Debug("Serving explorer static file", zap.String("path", filePath), zap.String("fullPath", fullPath))
480: 			http.ServeFile(w, r, fullPath)
481: 		})
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	// Serve the explorer index at /oracle and /explorer routes with injected config
485: 	r.HandleFunc("/oracle", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
486: 		indexPath := filepath.Join(s.webguiStaticDir, "index.html")
487: 		data, err := s.injectGatewayBase(indexPath)
488: 		if err != nil {
489: 			s.logger.Error("Failed to inject gateway base into index", zap.Error(err))
490: 			http.ServeFile(w, r, indexPath)
491: 			return

640: // findAvailablePort tries to listen on the given port, and if it's in use,
641: // tries subsequent ports until it finds one available.
642: func (s *Server) findAvailablePort(startPort int) (net.Listener, error) {
643: 	const maxAttempts = 100
644: 	for port := startPort; port < startPort+maxAttempts; port++ {
645: 		addr := fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port)
646: 		listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
647: 		if err != nil {
648: 			s.logger.Debug("Port in use, trying next",
649: 				zap.Int("port", port),
650: 				zap.Error(err),
651: 			)
652: 			continue
653: 		}
654: 		s.logger.Info("Found available port",
655: 			zap.Int("port", port),
656: 		)
657: 		return listener, nil
658: 	}
659: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf("no available port found after %d attempts", maxAttempts)
660: }

662: // Start starts the HTTP server
663: func (s *Server) Start() error {
664: 	ctx := context.Background()
665: 
666: 	// Start tunnel service
667: 	if err := s.tunnelService.Start(ctx); err != nil {
668: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start tunnel service: %w", err)
669: 	}
670: 
671: 	// Start payment service
672: 	if err := s.paymentService.Start(ctx); err != nil {
673: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start payment service: %w", err)
674: 	}
675: 
676: 	// Start TURN server with blockchain integration
677: 	if s.turnServer != nil {
678: 		if err := s.turnServer.Start(ctx); err != nil {
679: 			s.logger.Warn("Failed to start TURN server",
680: 				zap.Error(err))
681: 		}
682: 	}
683: 
684: 	// Setup CORS
685: 	c := cors.New(cors.Options{
686: 		AllowedOrigins:   []string{"*"},
687: 		AllowedMethods:   []string{"GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"},
688: 		AllowedHeaders:   []string{"*"},
689: 		AllowCredentials: true,
690: 	})
691: 
692: 	handler := c.Handler(wrapWithSecurityHeaders(s.router))
693: 
694: 	s.httpServer = &http.Server{
695: 		Addr:         fmt.Sprintf(":%d", s.config.Port),
696: 		Handler:      handler,
697: 		ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
698: 		WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
699: 		IdleTimeout:  120 * time.Second,
700: 	}
701: 
702: 	var listener net.Listener
703: 	var err error
704: 
705: 	// Listen on TCP port
706: 	listener, err = s.findAvailablePort(s.config.Port)
707: 	if err != nil {
708: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to find available port: %w", err)
709: 	}
710: 	// Extract the actual port from the listener
711: 	s.actualPort = listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
712: 	if s.actualPort != s.config.Port {
713: 		s.logger.Info("Using dynamic port",
714: 			zap.Int("port", s.actualPort),
715: 			zap.Int("requested", s.config.Port),
716: 		)
717: 	} else {
718: 		s.actualPort = s.config.Port
719: 	}
720: 
721: 	s.logger.Info("HTTP server listening",
722: 		zap.String("address", s.httpServer.Addr),
723: 	)
724: 
725: 	if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
726: 		return fmt.Errorf("server failed: %w", err)
727: 	}
728: 
729: 	return nil
730: }

732: // Stop gracefully stops the HTTP server
733: func (s *Server) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
734: 	if s.httpServer == nil {
735: 		return nil
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	s.logger.Info("Stopping HTTP server")
739: 
740: 	// Stop TURN server
741: 	if s.turnServer != nil {
742: 		if err := s.turnServer.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
743: 			s.logger.Error("Failed to stop TURN server", zap.Error(err))
744: 		}
745: 	}
746: 
747: 	// Stop tunnel service
748: 	if err := s.tunnelService.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
749: 		s.logger.Error("Failed to stop tunnel service", zap.Error(err))
750: 	}

752: 	// Stop payment service

754: 		s.logger.Error("Failed to stop payment service", zap.Error(err))

760: // injectGatewayBase reads an HTML file and injects a <script> tag with
761: // __GATEWAY_BASE__, __PAYMENT_API__, and KNIRV_GATEWAY_CONFIG configuration
762: // before </head>.  KNIRV_GATEWAY_CONFIG is read by gateway-links.js as its
763: // primary config source — without it the JS falls back to hardcoded
764: // localhost:3001 for the payment oracle health check and other endpoints.
765: func (s *Server) injectGatewayBase(filePath string) ([]byte, error) {
766: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(filePath)
767: 	if err != nil {
768: 		return nil, err
769: 	}
770: 	gatewayBase := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", s.config.Port)
771: 	script := fmt.Sprintf(
772: 		`<script>window.__GATEWAY_BASE__=%q;window.__PAYMENT_API__="/api/v1/payments";window.KNIRV_GATEWAY_CONFIG=%s;</script>`,
773: 		gatewayBase,
774: 		knirvGatewayConfigJSON(s.config),
775: 	)
776: 	injected := strings.Replace(string(data), "</head>", script+"</head>", 1)
777: 	return []byte(injected), nil
778: }

780: // knirvGatewayConfigJSON returns the JSON payload that gateway-links.js reads
781: // as window.KNIRV_GATEWAY_CONFIG.  This replaces the hardcoded fallback
782: // (localhost:3001) with actual gateway-proxied URLs so health checks work.
783: func knirvGatewayConfigJSON(cfg *config.Config) string {
784: 	gatewayPort := cfg.Port
785: 	if gatewayPort == 0 {
786: 		gatewayPort = 8080
787: 	}
788: 	base := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", gatewayPort)
789: 	// Use the same format gateway-links.js expects in its getFallbackConfiguration()
790: 	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"deployment_mode":"private_testnet","oracle_services":{"payment_oracle":{"base_url":"%[1]s/api/v1/payments/","health_url":"%[1]s/api/v1/payments/health","domain":"localhost","port":%[2]d,"path":"/api/v1/payments/"},"tunnel_registry":{"base_url":"%[1]s/api/v1/tunnels/","health_url":"%[1]s/api/v1/tunnels/status","domain":"localhost","port":%[2]d,"path":"/api/v1/tunnels/"},"operator_registry":{"base_url":"%[1]s/api/v1/operators/","health_url":"%[1]s/api/v1/operators/health","domain":"localhost","port":%[2]d,"path":"/api/v1/operators/"},"webgui":{"base_url":"%[1]s/","health_url":"%[1]s/health","domain":"localhost","port":%[2]d,"path":"/"}},"external_services":{"knirv_website":"https://knirv.com","testnet_access":"https://testnet.knirv.network"},"navigation":{},"timestamp":"%[3]s"}`,
791: 		base, gatewayPort, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
792: }

794: // wrapWithSecurityHeaders adds security-related HTTP headers to all responses.
795: func wrapWithSecurityHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
796: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
797: 		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN")
798: 		w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "frame-ancestors 'self' http://localhost:8090")
799: 		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
800: 		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
801: 	})
802: }

804: // newSocketProxy creates a reverse proxy that dials a Unix socket and forwards
805: // requests to the given target base URL.
806: func newSocketProxy(socketPath, targetBase string) *httputil.ReverseProxy {
807: 	transport := &http.Transport{
808: 		DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
809: 			return net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
810: 		},
811: 	}
812: 	target, _ := url.Parse(targetBase)
813: 	proxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(target)
814: 	proxy.Transport = transport
815: 	// Strip CORS headers from the upstream response so the gateway's own CORS
816: 	// middleware is the single authority.  Without this the backend can inject
817: 	// Access-Control-Allow-Origin alongside the gateway's wildcard, producing
818: 	// the "multiple values" error browsers reject.
819: 	proxy.ModifyResponse = func(resp *http.Response) error {
820: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Origin")
821: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Headers")
822: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Methods")
823: 		resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials")
824: 		return nil
825: 	}
826: 	return proxy
827: }

829: // dynamicAgentProxy returns an http.Handler that routes /api/agent/{dveId}/*
830: // to the per-DVE KNIRVAGENT's Unix socket (agent-{dveId}.sock).
831: // The proxy is created on first use and cached per DVE ID.
832: func (s *Server) dynamicAgentProxy() http.Handler {
833: 	var (
834: 		mu     sync.RWMutex
835: 		cache  = make(map[string]*httputil.ReverseProxy)
836: 	)
837: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
838: 		// Extract DVE ID from path: /api/agent/{dveId}/rest/of/path
839: 		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/agent/")
840: 		parts := strings.SplitN(path, "/", 2)
841: 		if len(parts) == 0 || parts[0] == "" {
842: 			http.Error(w, `{"error":"missing dve id"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
843: 			return
844: 		}
845: 		dveID := parts[0]
846: 
847: 		socketPath := filepath.Join(s.config.AgentSocketDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.sock", dveID))
848: 
849: 		// Check if socket exists before proxying
850: 		if _, err := os.Stat(socketPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
851: 			s.logger.Warn("Agent socket not found for DVE",
852: 				zap.String("dveID", dveID),
853: 				zap.String("socket", socketPath))
854: 			http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf(`{"error":"agent not running for dve %s"}`, dveID),
855: 				http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
856: 			return
857: 		}
858: 
859: 		// Get or create a cached proxy for this DVE
860: 		mu.RLock()
861: 		proxy, ok := cache[dveID]
862: 		mu.RUnlock()
863: 		if !ok {
864: 			mu.Lock()
865: 			// Double-check inside write lock
866: 			if proxy, ok = cache[dveID]; !ok {
867: 				targetBase := fmt.Sprintf("http://knirvagent-%s", dveID)
868: 				proxy = newSocketProxy(socketPath, targetBase)
869: 				cache[dveID] = proxy
870: 				s.logger.Info("Created agent proxy",
871: 					zap.String("dveID", dveID),
872: 					zap.String("socket", socketPath))
873: 			}
874: 			mu.Unlock()
875: 		}
876: 
877: 		// Rewrite the URL path: strip /api/agent/{dveId}
878: 		r.URL.Path = "/" + strings.Join(parts[1:], "/")
879: 		r.URL.RawPath = ""
880: 
881: 		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
882: 	})
883: }

75: 	if h.agentManager == nil || !h.agentManager.IsRunning() {
76: 		http.Error(w, "KNIRVAGENT supervisor not running", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
77: 		return
78: 	}
79: 
80: 	// Look up the per-DVE agent socket path from the AgentManager
81: 	socketPath, err := h.agentManager.GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID)
82: 	if err != nil {
83: 		log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] No agent socket for node %s: %v", nodeID, err)
84: 		http.Error(w, "No KNIRVAGENT running for this DVE: "+err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
85: 		return
86: 	}
87: 
88: 	// Create an HTTP client that dials the agent's Unix socket.
89: 	// No client-level Timeout: LLM calls via the fallback chain can easily take
90: 	// more than 30 seconds.  Each forwardInput call uses its own per-request
91: 	// context with a 5-minute deadline instead.
92: 	unixClient := &http.Client{
93: 		Transport: &http.Transport{
94: 			DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
95: 				return net.DialTimeout("unix", socketPath, 5*time.Second)
96: 			},
97: 		},
98: 	}
99: 
100: 	conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
101: 	if err != nil {
102: 		log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] Upgrade error for node %s: %v", nodeID, err)
103: 		return
104: 	}
105: 
106: 	wsConn := &agentWSConn{
107: 		nodeID:     nodeID,
108: 		conn:       conn,
109: 		send:       make(chan []byte, 256),
110: 		socketPath: socketPath,
111: 		lastSeen:   time.Now(),
112: 		agentHTTP:  unixClient,
113: 	}
114: 
115: 	h.mu.Lock()
116: 	if existing, ok := h.active[nodeID]; ok {
117: 		existing.conn.Close()
118: 	}
119: 	h.active[nodeID] = wsConn
120: 	h.mu.Unlock()
121: 
122: 	log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] Connected: node=%s socket=%s", nodeID, socketPath)
123: 
124: 	// Send hello message and prompt to the frontend terminal
125: 	wsConn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
126: 		Type: "data",
127: 		Data: "\x1b[1;35m╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\x1b[0m\r\n" +
128: 			"\x1b[1;35m║  KNIRVAGENT DVE Supervisor v1.1.0                        ║\x1b[0m\r\n" +
129: 			"\x1b[1;35m║  Status: ACTIVE                                           ║\x1b[0m\r\n" +
130: 			"\x1b[1;35m║  DVE: " + nodeID + "\x1b[0m\r\n" +
131: 			"\x1b[1;35m╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\x1b[0m\r\n" +
132: 			"\x1b[35mType 'help' for available commands or 'exit' to disconnect.\x1b[0m\r\n",
133: 	})
134: 	wsConn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{Type: "prompt", Data: ""})
135: 
136: 	go h.writePump(wsConn)
137: 	go h.readPump(wsConn)
138: }
139: 
140: // readPump reads messages from the WebSocket and forwards them to the KNIRVAGENT.
141: func (h *DVEAgentWSHandler) readPump(conn *agentWSConn) {
142: 	defer func() {
143: 		h.mu.Lock()
144: 		delete(h.active, conn.nodeID)
145: 		h.mu.Unlock()
146: 		conn.conn.Close()
147: 	}()
148: 
149: 	conn.conn.SetReadLimit(65536)
150: 	conn.conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Minute))
151: 	conn.conn.SetPongHandler(func(string) error {
152: 		conn.mu.Lock()
153: 		conn.lastSeen = time.Now()
154: 		conn.mu.Unlock()
155: 		conn.conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Minute))
156: 		return nil
157: 	})
158: 
159: 	for {
160: 		_, message, err := conn.conn.ReadMessage()
161: 		if err != nil {
162: 			if websocket.IsUnexpectedCloseError(err, websocket.CloseGoingAway, websocket.CloseNormalClosure) {
163: 				log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] Read error node=%s: %v", conn.nodeID, err)
164: 			}
165: 			break
166: 		}
167: 
168: 		var msg agentWSMessage
169: 		if err := json.Unmarshal(message, &msg); err != nil {
170: 			log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] Invalid message from node=%s: %v", conn.nodeID, err)
171: 			continue
172: 		}
173: 
174: 		switch msg.Type {
175: 		case "input":
176: 			var inputStr string
177: 			if err := json.Unmarshal(msg.Data, &inputStr); err != nil {
178: 				log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] Invalid input data from node=%s: %v", conn.nodeID, err)
179: 				continue
180: 			}
181: 			go h.forwardInput(conn, inputStr)
182: 		case "ping":
183: 			conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{Type: "pong", Data: ""})
184: 		default:
185: 			log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] Unknown message type from node=%s: %s", conn.nodeID, msg.Type)
186: 		}
187: 	}
188: }
189: 
190: // writePump writes messages from the send channel to the WebSocket connection.
191: func (h *DVEAgentWSHandler) writePump(conn *agentWSConn) {
192: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(30 * time.Second)
193: 	defer func() {
194: 		ticker.Stop()
195: 		conn.conn.Close()
196: 	}()
197: 
198: 	for {
199: 		select {
200: 		case message, ok := <-conn.send:
201: 			if !ok {
202: 				conn.conn.WriteMessage(websocket.CloseMessage, []byte{})
203: 				return
204: 			}
205: 			conn.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
206: 			if err := conn.conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, message); err != nil {
207: 				log.Printf("[DVE Agent WS] Write error node=%s: %v", conn.nodeID, err)
208: 				return
209: 			}
210: 		case <-ticker.C:
211: 			conn.conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
212: 			if err := conn.conn.WriteMessage(websocket.PingMessage, nil); err != nil {
213: 				return
214: 			}
215: 		}
216: 	}
217: }
218: 
219: // forwardInput sends a command to the KNIRVAGENT's /api/execute endpoint via
220: // Unix socket and writes the response back to the WebSocket send channel.
221: func (h *DVEAgentWSHandler) forwardInput(conn *agentWSConn, input string) {
222: 	if input == "" {
223: 		return
224: 	}
225: 
226: 	payload := map[string]string{"command": input}
227: 	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
228: 	if err != nil {
229: 		conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
230: 			Type: "data",
231: 			Data: fmt.Sprintf("\x1b[31m[ERROR] Failed to encode command: %v\x1b[0m\r\n", err),
232: 		})
233: 		return
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	// Give each LLM call up to 5 minutes — enough for a fallback chain and a
237: 	// slow provider response.  The KNIRVAGENT honours request cancellation, so
238: 	// this deadline propagates through to the underlying LLM call.
239: 	reqCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Minute)
240: 	defer cancel()
241: 
242: 	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(reqCtx, http.MethodPost,
243: 		"http://localhost/api/execute", bytes.NewReader(body))
244: 	if err != nil {
245: 		conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
246: 			Type: "data",
247: 			Data: fmt.Sprintf("\x1b[31m[ERROR] Failed to build request: %v\x1b[0m\r\n", err),
248: 		})
249: 		return
250: 	}
251: 	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
252: 
253: 	resp, err := conn.agentHTTP.Do(req)
254: 	if err != nil {
255: 		conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
256: 			Type: "data",
257: 			Data: fmt.Sprintf("\x1b[31m[ERROR] KNIRVAGENT unreachable (socket: %s): %v\x1b[0m\r\n", conn.socketPath, err),
258: 		})
259: 		return
260: 	}
261: 	defer resp.Body.Close()
262: 
263: 	respBody, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 65536))
264: 	if err != nil {
265: 		conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
266: 			Type: "data",
267: 			Data: fmt.Sprintf("\x1b[31m[ERROR] Failed to read response: %v\x1b[0m\r\n", err),
268: 		})
269: 		return
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	var agentResp struct {
273: 		Output  string `json:"output"`
274: 		Success bool   `json:"success"`
275: 		Error   string `json:"error,omitempty"`
276: 	}
277: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(respBody, &agentResp); err != nil {
278: 		conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
279: 			Type: "data",
280: 			Data: string(respBody) + "\r\n",
281: 		})
282: 	} else {
283: 		if !agentResp.Success && agentResp.Error != "" {
284: 			conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
285: 				Type: "data",
286: 				Data: fmt.Sprintf("\x1b[31m%s\x1b[0m\r\n", agentResp.Error),
287: 			})
288: 		} else if agentResp.Output != "" {
289: 			conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{
290: 				Type: "data",
291: 				Data: agentResp.Output,
292: 			})
293: 		}
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	conn.send <- mustMarshal(agentWSResponse{Type: "prompt", Data: ""})
297: }
298: 
299: // RegisterRoutes registers the WebSocket endpoint on the router.
300: func (h *DVEAgentWSHandler) RegisterRoutes(r *mux.Router) {
301: 	r.HandleFunc("/ws/dve/{nodeId}/agent", h.HandleWebSocket)
302: }
303: 
304: func mustMarshal(v interface{}) []byte {
305: 	data, _ := json.Marshal(v)
306: 	return data
307: }
